name: backseat-driver
description: A coding tutor that rides along while you write the code yourself. It watches your saves, comments in a side pane, reviews commits in depth, and never edits your files.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Where the tutor shows itself. unified: a few lines above the prompt that open into the tabs when you ask, and a line under the prompt; no pane. horizontal: the whole view in a frame above the prompt, side by side. vertical: the whole view in a pane, which sits beside the conversation in Claude Code's fullscreen layout. /bsd layout switches it.

voice.title: Voice persona
voice.description: How the tutor talks: its tone, wording and teaching style. It never changes what the tutor recommends, or the ground rules.

engineering.title: Engineering persona
engineering.description: Whose engineering judgment the tutor reviews with: what it values, what it flags and which approach it recommends. "default" is Claude's own judgment, not tilted toward anyone's. It never changes the ground rules.

animated_persona.title: Animated persona
animated_persona.description: A small character in the pane that speaks for the voice persona: a line at the critical and decision points in your code, and now and then a joke. Off keeps the pane plain.

play_by_play.title: Play-by-play
play_by_play.description: Whether the running commentary looks at your changes by itself or only when you ask.

quiet_time.title: Play-by-play quiet time
quiet_time.description: How long the working tree must be still before the play-by-play looks.

minimum_gap.title: Play-by-play minimum gap
minimum_gap.description: The shortest time between two play-by-play looks.

play_by_play_model.title: Play-by-play model
play_by_play_model.description: The model that writes the running commentary.

play_by_play_thinking.title: Play-by-play thinking level
play_by_play_thinking.description: How hard the play-by-play model thinks about each look.

deep_review_after_commit.title: Deep review after each commit
deep_review_after_commit.description: Review each commit in depth as soon as you make it.

deep_review_every.title: Deep review every
deep_review_every.description: Also run a deep review on a timer, covering everything since the previous one.

deep_review_model.title: Deep review model
deep_review_model.description: The model that writes deep reviews and gives second opinions.

deep_review_thinking.title: Deep review thinking level
deep_review_thinking.description: How hard the deep review model thinks.

explain.title: Explain
explain.description: When the Explain tab looks code up: as you move and save, only when you ask, or never.

explain_model.title: Explain model
explain_model.description: The model that explains the code you are reading.

explain_thinking.title: Explain thinking level
explain_thinking.description: How hard the explain model thinks. Lower is faster.

progress_report.title: Progress report
progress_report.description: Keep an honest record of your level in each language, judged only on commits that are yours. Each commit of yours costs one request on the deep review model.

update_check.title: Check for updates
update_check.description: Ask the plugin's GitHub repository for a newer release, at most every six hours while the tutor is on, and say so in the pane. /bsd update fetches it.
